children: RNS Number : 6666D  Litigation Capital Management Ltd  18 November 2026

Litigation Capital Management Limited (LCM), an alternative asset manager specialising in dispute financing solutions internationally, announces that the appeal in an Australian class action funded by LCM has been unsuccessful.  This investment was held at a value of A$7.7 million as at 30 June 2026 and that amount will now be written off.
Giles Balleny and Isaac Hooper (Corporate Finance)
